services.desc: Ready for an unforgettable day on the water? We offer kayak, tandem kayak, paddleboard, and canoe rentals from two fantastic Pinellas County locations: Clearwater Beach and Cove Cay Marina. For an iconic Florida experience, choose our Clearwater Beach kayak rental or Clearwater Beach paddleboard rental. Explore the stunning Gulf waters, paddle past famous sugar-sand beaches, and potentially spot local marine life. Our convenient Clearwater Beach location puts you right in the heart of the action.
